updates.title: Website — Deploy & Cache
updates.summary: Improved how pickaxe-tycoon.xyz deploys so new builds show up immediately without stale CSS or cached HTML.
highlights: GitHub Actions now purges Cloudflare CDN cache after every deploy
Cache headers: HTML always revalidates; hashed JS/CSS cached long-term
Fixes occasional “no styles” after deploy when browsers held old HTML

updates.title: Website — SEO & Crawling
updates.summary: Search-engine and crawler fixes for pickaxe-tycoon.xyz — sitemap, robots.txt, and broken email links.
highlights: Sitemap trimmed to 10 indexable pages; robots.txt generated at build time
Blocked /go/, /yt/, and /cdn-cgi/ from crawlers (tracking + Cloudflare junk paths)
Fixed Cloudflare email-protection 404 links on About, Terms, and Privacy
H3 headings and optimized meta titles/descriptions on all guide pages

updates.title: Website — Mobile & Navigation
updates.summary: Better navigation and phone layout across the fan guide site.
highlights: Active page highlight in header (desktop + mobile)
Hamburger menu with full-screen overlay on small screens
Responsive spacing on calculator, tier list, codes, wiki, and footer
YouTube comment short links: pickaxe-tycoon.xyz/c, /b, /t, /w

updates.title: Magmatic Cavern Expansion
updates.summary: Major expansion of Magmatic Cavern with new ores, combat improvements, and a locked gate to future content.
highlights: Expanded Magmatic Cavern area with gate to new zone (not ready yet)
New ores: Amber and Kunzite in Magmatic Cavern
New boss: Galatean Warrior in Magmatic Caverns
Pickaxe Workshop — upgrade pickaxe damage and toughness resistance
Sword hit cooldown reduced from 0.2s to 0.11s
Items now persist through death
In-game feedback option in Settings menu
Mining hit registration and performance optimizations

updates.title: Magmatic Cavern Patch
updates.summary: Follow-up patch fixing Magmatic Cavern map errors and UI issues.
highlights: Fixed map error in Magmatic Cavern area
UI fixes for smaller screen resolutions
Client and server optimizations (saving ~1ms on clients)

updates.title: Daily Rewards System
updates.summary: Added daily reward system with free Money, Boosters, Items, and even gamepass perks.
highlights: Claim free daily rewards every day (resets 00:00 UTC)
Rewards include Money, Boosters, Items, and gamepass perks
UI blur and zoom effects when opening menus

updates.title: Game Launch
updates.summary: Pickaxe Tycoon officially launched on Roblox by Popular Marketplace.
highlights: Core loop: buy pickaxes, mine ores, merge upgrades, build mining tower
24 pickaxes in the index (Wood to Legendary)
Gamepasses: Auto Money (29R$), Auto Loot (79R$), Double Ore (499R$), 2x All Money (12R$)
Ore Multiplier peaks at 1.5x every 30 seconds
